era: 1941- : 东京都—所沢—小金井（吉卜力工作室）
school: 吉卜力工作室 / 日本动画
historical_significance: 宫崎骏（1941-）日本动画导演、吉卜力工作室联合创始人。他以手绘动画、原创世界观与对自然/技术/战争的主题坚持，把日本动画提升为世界性的作者电影：《风之谷》《龙猫》《千与千寻》（奥斯卡最佳动画长片）、《幽灵公主》《起风了》等作品在商业成功与艺术深度上同时抵达罕见的高度。他的方法论——世界观先于情节、日常巨物并置、两难不加裁决、手绘观察、空间共在的工作坊组织——构成了动画创作乃至更广创作领域的可迁移思维模式体系。
historical_significance_en: Hayao Miyazaki (1941-) is a Japanese animation director and co-founder of Studio Ghibli. Through hand-drawn animation, original worldviews, and thematic persistence on nature, technology, and war, he elevated Japanese animation into world-scale auteur cinema: Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind, My Neighbor Totoro, Spirited Away (Academy Award for Best Animated Feature), Princess Mononoke, and The Wind Rises each reached a rare simultaneous height of commercial success and artistic depth. His methodology—worldview before plot, juxtaposition of the mundane and the colossal, dilemma without adjudication, hand-drawn observation, and the shared-workshop organization of space—constitutes a transferable system of thinking modes for animation creation and creative work far beyond it.
unique_thinking: 把道德宇宙的建立置于情节之前，以手绘观察为全部质感的地基，用不加裁决的两难与日常巨物的并置保存世界的重量，并以空间共在的工作坊组织手工艺协作。
unique_thinking_en: Placing the building of a moral universe before plot, grounding all texture in hand-drawn observation, preserving the world's weight through unadjudicated dilemmas and the juxtaposition of the mundane with the colossal, and organizing craft collaboration through the spatial co-presence of the workshop.

modes.domain_zh: 把作品的道德宇宙（自然观/善恶观/技术观）先于情节和角色设定完成，使每个情节决定都能回溯到一个已建立的价值体系
modes.domain_en: Completing the work's moral universe—its view of nature, good and evil, and technology—before plot or characters, so that every story decision can be traced back to an established value system
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏创作方法的第一原理：先宇宙，后情节。大多数商业动画从'一个好故事'出发，宫崎骏从'一个世界如何运转、什么是恶、人应站在哪里'出发。方法有三步：其一，先建立世界观档案——在写第一格分镜之前，这部作品对自然的立场（敬畏还是征服）、对技术的立场（工具还是毒药）、对战争的立场已经落纸；其二，情节作为世界观的检验场——剧情不是用来制造悬念的装置，而是把世界观放到极端条件下观察其是否自洽：风之谷里腐海净化被污染的世界，剧情的一切转折都服从这条设定；其三，世界观必须付出代价——一个只有设定没有代价的世界是布景，幽灵公主中人与森林诸神冲突的双方都付出了真实的血，世界观的重量由此才立得住。深意在于：情节的连贯性其实是价值观的连贯性，观众感到'故事散了'，往往是价值观在某一处没有坚持住。《风之谷》漫画连载十二年，前两卷几乎只在世界观中行走，情节密度极低——正是这十二年的宇宙工程让后十卷的每个情节都有根。现代对应物是组织使命宣言先于 KPI 与产品价值观先于功能列表：先定不可协商之物，再谈效率。
modes.definition_en: The first principle of Miyazaki's creative method: universe first, plot after. Most commercial animation begins from 'a good story'; Miyazaki begins from 'how does this world work, what is evil, where must a person stand.' The method has three steps. First, build the worldview dossier: before the first storyboard panel, the work's stance toward nature (reverence or conquest), toward technology (tool or poison), toward war is already on paper. Second, plot as the testing ground of the worldview: the story is not a suspense device but an experiment placing the worldview under extreme conditions to see whether it stays self-consistent—in Nausicaa the Sea of Corruption purifies a poisoned world, and every turn of the plot obeys that premise. Third, a worldview must pay its price: a world with settings but no costs is mere scenery; in Princess Mononoke both sides of the conflict between humans and the forest gods pay in real blood, and only then does the worldview carry weight. The deeper point: narrative coherence is the coherence of values—when an audience feels 'the story fell apart,' it is usually because a value was not upheld somewhere. The Nausicaa manga ran for twelve years, its first two volumes walking almost entirely inside the worldview with minimal plot—twelve years of universe-engineering that gave every later episode its roots. Modern analogues: organizational mission statements before KPIs, product values before feature lists—settle what is non-negotiable, then talk efficiency.
modes.source_chapter: 《风之谷》漫画 (Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind, 1982-1994)；吉卜力工作室创作笔记
modes.key_quote_zh: 我从不先想'接下来发生什么'——我先想'这个世界里什么是对的'，接下来发生的一切都会自己长出来。
modes.key_quote_en: I never think 'what happens next' first—I think 'what is right in this world,' and everything that happens next grows out of it.
process_zh: 先写世界观档案：明确作品对自然/技术/战争/善恶的根本立场，落纸为不可协商条款
情节检验：设计极端情境测试世界观自洽性，任何情节转折都必须能回溯到世界观条款
强制代价：为世界观的每条核心设定设计真实代价（牺牲/两难/不可逆损失），无代价的设定删除
一致性复盘：全稿完成后逐场检查价值观是否漂移，漂移处按世界观修正情节而非相反
process_en: Write the worldview dossier first: settle the work's fundamental stances on nature/technology/war/good-and-evil as non-negotiable clauses on paper
Plot stress-testing: design extreme situations to test worldview self-consistency; every plot turn must trace back to a worldview clause
Mandatory costs: design real costs (sacrifice, dilemma, irreversible loss) for every core setting; delete settings that cost nothing
Consistency review: after the full draft, check scene by scene for value drift; where drift occurs, fix the plot to the worldview, never the reverse
representative_cases_zh: 《风之谷》漫画前两卷（1982-1984）：情节密度极低，全部篇幅用于建立腐海生态、风之谷社会与王虫的世界规则，为后十卷的宏大情节打下自洽地基
《幽灵公主》(1997)：人类文明与森林诸神双方都付出真实血代价，达达拉城与麒麟森林都没有被漫画化——世界观的重量来自双方都有理且都有代价
《千与千寻》(2001)：油屋世界的规则（名字被夺即失去自我/不劳而食者变猪）在第一幕全部建立，后续所有情节都是规则的展开而非新设定的追加
反例警示：世界观先于情节不等于世界观替代情节——《地海战记》由宫崎吾朗执导、宫崎骏公开表示反对，影片有世界观有画面但情节检验缺失，被普遍认为空洞；价值必须经过情节的极端测试才成立
representative_cases_en: Nausicaa manga, vols. 1-2 (1982-1984): minimal plot density; every page builds the Sea of Corruption's ecology, the Valley's society, and the Ohmu's world rules—a self-consistent foundation for the epic plot of the later ten volumes

Princess Mononoke (1997): both human civilization and the forest gods pay a real price in blood; neither Tatara's iron town nor the Cedar Forest is caricatured—the worldview's weight comes from both sides being right and both paying

Spirited Away (2001): the bathhouse's rules (lose your name, lose yourself; idle eaters become pigs) are fully established in act one; every later episode unfolds existing rules rather than appending new settings

Counter-case: Tales from Earthsea—directed by Goro Miyazaki over Hayao Miyazaki's public objection; it has a worldview and imagery but no plot stress-testing, and is widely judged hollow; values must pass plot's extreme test to hold
modern_applications_zh: 组织使命设计：把使命写成可检验的立场（我们拒绝什么/我们愿意付出什么），战略与 KPI 先过使命压力测试再批准
产品价值观先于功能列表：先定不可协商条款（隐私底线/美学红线），任何功能决策必须能回溯到条款
严肃游戏与仿真设计：先建立系统规则，再把场景生成为规则一致性的极端测试用例
写作与编剧课程：用'道德宇宙档案+情节压力测试'替代'先列情节大纲'，把故事当作价值观一致性工程来教
modern_applications_en: M-MIY-002

modes.domain_zh: 以大量手绘草图和长时间凝视真实对象为创作基础设施，用手的记忆代替资料检索，把观察积累直接转化为运动的质感
modes.domain_en: Building creation on masses of hand-drawn sketches and long gazing at real subjects, replacing reference lookup with the hand's memory and converting accumulated observation directly into texture of movement
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏把'画'当作'看'的完成形态：不能画出来的东西等于没有真正看见。方法有三步：其一，写生先于设计——吉卜力每部作品前期都有成箱的写生，龙猫的森林来自所沢的杂木林写生，红猪的水上飞机来自亚得里亚海旧机摄影；其二，运动观察优先于形状观察——他要求团队画的不是'鸟的样子'而是'鸟起飞时身体的顺序'，《魔女宅急便》乌鸦群与《红猪》飞行段的重量感都来自对运动顺序的逐帧拆解；其三，手的记忆建成素材库——画过千次的手不必查资料，波妞的海浪画法是他数十年海边观察的肌肉记忆。深意在于：手绘的慢不是低效，而是把观察强制编码进身体的必要时间——快门可以替代眼睛，但不能替代手对对象的理解。他坚持赛璐璐手绘到吉卜力几乎成为行业孤例，代价是《幽灵公主》十五万张手绘的巨额成本，收益是每帧都带着观察的温度。现代对应物是设计领域的'第一性观察'：真正理解用户不是读调研报告，而是像设计师在用户现场一站一天。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki treats drawing as the completed form of seeing: what you cannot draw, you have not truly seen. The method has three steps. First, field sketching precedes design—every Ghibli production begins with crates of life drawings; the forest of Totoro comes from sketching the mixed woods of Tokorozawa, Porco's seaplanes from photographing old aircraft on the Adriatic. Second, observing motion before observing shape—he asks the team to draw not 'what a bird looks like' but 'the sequence of a bird's body at takeoff'; the weight of the crow swarms in Kiki's Delivery Service and the flight scenes of Porco Rosso comes from frame-by-frame breakdown of movement order. Third, the hand's memory becomes a library—a hand that has drawn a thousand times need not consult references; the waves of Ponyo are decades of seaside observation stored as muscle memory. The deeper point: the slowness of hand-drawing is not inefficiency but the necessary time for forcing observation into the body—a shutter can replace the eye, but not the hand's understanding of its subject. He held onto cel-style hand-drawing until Ghibli became nearly alone in the industry; the cost was the enormous budget of Princess Mononoke's 150,000 hand-drawn frames, the return was that every frame carries the warmth of observation. Modern analogue: first-hand observation in design—truly understanding users means standing at their site all day, not reading research reports.
modes.source_chapter: 《出发点》(Starting Point, 1996) 文集；吉卜力工作室制作方法纪录片《梦境与疯狂的王国》
modes.key_quote_zh: 画不出来的东西，就是还没看懂的东西——手会替眼睛记住眼睛自己都不知道的东西。
modes.key_quote_en: What you cannot draw is what you have not understood—your hand remembers for your eyes things the eyes themselves do not know.
process_zh: 写生先于设计：为作品的核心对象（生态/机械/城市/动作）建立成箱的现场写生，不许只靠照片
运动拆解：对关键动作逐帧观察顺序与重量转移，画'发生的顺序'而非'事物的样子'
手的记忆库：把写生按对象分类复画，直到不查资料能画出任一角度，形成肌肉记忆素材库
质感验收：每批成片检查是否带有'观察的温度'——画不出的细节回炉补写生而非查图应付
process_en: Field sketching before design: build crates of on-site sketches for the work's core subjects (ecology, machines, cities, actions)—photos alone are not allowed
Motion breakdown: observe key movements frame by frame for sequence and weight transfer; draw 'the order of happening,' not 'what things look like'
Hand-memory library: re-draw sketches classified by subject until any angle can be drawn without references, forming a muscle-memory asset
Texture acceptance: check every batch of finished frames for 'the warmth of observation'—un-drawable details go back to the field, not to stock images
representative_cases_zh: 《龙猫》(1988)：所沢杂木林的成箱写生直接转化为影片的森林质感，樟树神社、田间小径的细节全部来自现场
《红猪》(1992)：亚得里亚海旧水上飞机的实地摄影与机械写生，让幻想作品的飞行器带有真实机械的重量感
《悬崖上的金鱼姬》(2008)：波妞的海浪全片手绘，宫崎骏要求团队看真实海浪数月，浪的生命感来自对运动顺序的逐帧拆解
反例警示：观察积累无法外包——过度依赖照片与素材库的动画团队产出'看起来对'但缺乏重量的运动；快门可以替代眼睛，不能替代手对对象的理解
representative_cases_en: My Neighbor Totoro (1988): crates of sketches of the mixed woods of Tokorozawa convert directly into the film's forest texture—camphor shrine and farm-path details all come from the field
Porco Rosso (1992): on-site photography and mechanical sketches of old seaplanes on the Adriatic give the fantasy aircraft the weight of real machinery
Ponyo (2008): hand-drawn waves throughout; Miyazaki had the team watch real ocean waves for months—the life in the waves comes from frame-by-frame breakdown of movement order

Counter-case: observation cannot be outsourced—teams over-reliant on photo libraries produce motion that 'looks right' but lacks weight; the shutter can replace the eye, not the hand's understanding of the subject
modern_applications_zh: 用户研究：用一整天的现场观察替代读调研报告， findings 通过手工重绘/重建用户旅程来编码
工业设计：CAD 之前强制实物素描与机构动手拆装，建立设计者对对象的手部记忆
运动训练：用运动顺序与重心转移的逐帧视频拆解替代静态姿势快照
数据叙事：分析师在自动化报表之前手工端到端追踪一条完整数据旅程——'用手认识数据'
modern_applications_en: UX research: replace report-reading with day-long on-site observation; encode findings by re-drawing/rebuilding the user journey by hand
Industrial design: mandatory physical sketching and hands-on mockups of real mechanisms before CAD, building the designer's hand memory of the subject
Athletic coaching: video breakdown of movement order and weight transfer rather than static form snapshots
Data storytelling: analysts manually trace one full data journey end-to-end before automating dashboards—knowing the data by hand

modes.domain_zh: 以'飞行'作为贯穿全部作品的统一母题：同一意象在不同作品中复用为逃避、成长、俯瞰与解放等相反含义，形成不解释的私有意象语法
modes.domain_en: Using 'flight' as the unifying motif across an entire oeuvre: the same image reused across works as escape, growth, detachment, and liberation—opposite meanings forming an unexplained private grammar of imagery
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏的全部主要作品共享一个母题：飞行。关键在于他让同一意象承担相反的含义而不加解释——《红猪》的飞行是逃避现实的自罚，魔女琪琪的飞行是成长的自证，娜乌西卡的飞行是介入世界的意志，飞行员与滑翔机又反复指向他对航空史的痴迷与战争机器的警惕。方法有三步：其一，选定可承载多重语义的身体性意象——飞行之所以胜任，因为它同时是物理事实、情感状态与道德处境；其二，让意象自义——凡到需要台词解释意象含义的地方，宁可删台词：观众通过意象的重复与变奏自行完成释义；其三，建立个人意象词典——母题在作品中反复出现形成互文网络，后来的作品免费继承此前积累的全部语义层。深意在于：私有意象语法是作者性的最深处标记——情节可以被复制，但一个意象三十年的复用轨迹无法被复制。现代对应物是品牌的核心隐喻系统与作家的私有意象库。
modes.definition_en: All of Miyazaki's major works share one motif: flight. The key is that he lets the same image carry opposite meanings without explanation—Porco Rosso's flying is self-punishing escape, Kiki's flying is proof of growth, Nausicaa's flying is the will to engage the world, while pilots and gliders repeatedly point to both his obsession with aviation history and his dread of war machines. The method has three steps. First, choose a bodily image that can bear multiple semantics: flight qualifies because it is at once physical fact, emotional state, and moral position. Second, let the image speak for itself: wherever a line of dialogue would be needed to explain the image's meaning, cut the line—the audience completes the interpretation through the image's repetition and variation. Third, build a personal imagery dictionary: the motif recurs across works forming an intertextual network, and later works inherit free of charge every semantic layer previously accumulated. The deeper point: a private grammar of imagery is the deepest signature of authorship—plots can be copied, but a thirty-year trajectory of reusing one image cannot. Modern analogues: a brand's core metaphor system, or a writer's private image bank.
modes.source_chapter: 《出发点》《折返点》(Starting Point / Turning Point) 文集；全作品年表
modes.key_quote_zh: 飞行对我而言从来不是一个设定，而是一个问题——人离开地面之后，是更自由了，还是更危险了。
modes.key_quote_en: Flight was never a setting for me but a question—once a person leaves the ground, are they freer, or in greater danger?
process_zh: 选定身体性母题：找一个同时是物理事实、情感状态与道德处境的核心意象，长期锁定
删除解释：剧本凡出现解释母题含义的台词一律删除，让意象通过重复与变奏自义
变奏复用：每部作品让母题承担一种与前作不同甚至相反的语义，扩展意象词典
互文审计：新作品立项时检查母题的既有语义层，确认新变奏与之形成对话而非重复
process_en: Lock in a bodily motif: find one core image that is at once physical fact, emotional state, and moral position, and hold it long-term
Cut all explanation: delete any line of dialogue explaining the motif's meaning; let the image define itself through repetition and variation
Reuse by variation: each new work gives the motif one new or even opposite semantic charge, expanding the imagery dictionary
Intertext audit: at project kickoff, review the motif's existing semantic layers and confirm the new variation converses with them rather than repeating
representative_cases_zh: 《风之谷》(1984) 滑翔翼：娜乌西卡的飞行是介入与沟通的意志，走向王虫群时飞行是谦卑的接近而非征服
《魔女宅急便》(1989)：琪琪的飞行从天真的天赋到因自我怀疑而失落再到靠'不是为了给别人看'恢复——飞行是成长状态的心理测量仪
《红猪》(1992)：'不能飞的猪就只是普通的猪'——中年飞行员的飞行是逃避与荣誉的混合体，与前作的成长语义相反
《起风了》(2013)：堀越二郎的飞机设计之美与战争用途的撕裂——母题的语义层最终落到'创造者无法控制造物的去向'，完成三十年意象词典的收束
representative_cases_en: Nausicaa (1984) glider: Nausicaa's flight is the will to engage and communicate—flying toward the Ohmu swarm is humble approach, not conquest
Kiki's Delivery Service (1989): Kiki's flight moves from innocent gift to loss through self-doubt to recovery by 'not flying for others'—flight as a psychological gauge of growth
Porco Rosso (1992): 'a pig that can't fly is just a pig'—the middle-aged pilot's flight is a mix of escape and honor, the reverse of the coming-of-age semantics

The Wind Rises (2013): Jiro Horikoshi's torn love of aeronautical beauty and its war use—the motif's semantic layer lands on 'the creator cannot control where the creation goes,' closing the thirty-year imagery dictionary
modern_applications_zh: 品牌隐喻系统：维护一个核心意象（如'思维的工具'）跨产品代际做语义变奏，而非每代发明新口号
个人知识管理：建立私人意象/类比库跨文章复用，让每篇新作品免费继承已积累的语义层
广告战役设计：一个视觉母题跨年度复用并做刻意语义变奏，积累受众侧的互文记忆
建筑实践：一个签名空间母题（光/门槛/动线）逐项目变奏，替代风格大杂烩
modern_applications_en: Brand metaphor systems: maintain a core image (e.g. 'tools for the mind') and vary its meaning across product generations rather than inventing new slogans
Personal knowledge management: build a private image/analogy bank reused across essays so each piece inherits accumulated meaning
Campaign design: reuse one visual motif across years of campaigns with deliberate semantic variation, building audience-side intertext
Architectural practice: one signature spatial motif (light, threshold, circulation) varied per project instead of a style grab-bag

modes.domain_zh: 呈现价值冲突时拒绝给出裁决者立场：冲突双方都被赋予真实的理由与代价，观众被留在两难中自行判断
modes.domain_en: When presenting value conflicts, refuse to take the adjudicator's stance: both sides are given real reasons and real costs, and the audience is left inside the dilemma to judge for itself
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏处理主题冲突的标志立场：他不站在任何一边。幽灵公主中，炼铁的达达拉城接纳麻风病人与被卖的女性，是进步与慈悲的；森林诸神被人类砍伐驱逐，是受害者——但野猪神的疯狂也在屠戮无辜。宫崎骏拒绝告诉观众该站在哪边，他只把双方的血都端上台面。方法有三步：其一，给双方同等的理由与尊严——先分别为冲突各方写出'他们为什么有理'的最强论证，任何一方写不出强论证就重构冲突；其二，让代价双向流动——冲突的每一方都必须付出可见的代价，不允许一方全赢；其三，克制裁决冲动——把'你该同情谁'的问题原样交给观众，导演的立场最多以偏爱的镜头语言渗透，不进入台词与结局。深意在于：不加裁决不是没有立场，而是相信观众在两难中的自我裁决比接受导演的结论更深刻——作品把观众变成思考者而非接受者。《幽灵公主》结尾没有宣布人与自然的和解方案，只说'一起活下去'——这句话是提问，不是答案。现代对应物是公共政策辩论中的'钢人论证'要求与调查记者的多方呈现纪律。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki's signature stance toward thematic conflict: he takes no side. In Princess Mononoke, Tatara's iron town takes in lepers and bought women—progressive and compassionate; the forest gods, felled and driven out, are victims—yet the boar god's madness slaughters the innocent. Miyazaki refuses to tell the audience whom to back; he simply puts both sides' blood on the table. The method has three steps. First, equal reasons and dignity for both sides: write the strongest case for 'why they are right' for each party; if any party yields no strong case, rebuild the conflict. Second, costs must flow both ways: every party to the conflict pays a visible price; no side may win outright. Third, restrain the urge to adjudicate: hand the question 'whom should you pity' untouched to the audience; the director's leaning may at most permeate the camera language, never the dialogue or the ending. The deeper point: not adjudicating is not having no position—it is the belief that the audience's self-verdict inside a dilemma cuts deeper than accepting the director's conclusion; the work turns viewers into thinkers rather than receivers. Princess Mononoke ends with no announced plan for human-nature reconciliation, only 'live together'—a question, not an answer. Modern analogues: steelmanning in public-policy debate and multi-source discipline in investigative journalism.
modes.source_chapter: 《幽灵公主》(1997) 制作资料；《出发点》文集关于主题的章节
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不拍告诉观众该怎么想的电影——我把两面都做厚，剩下的判断是观众自己的事，那才是电影真正开始的地方。
modes.key_quote_en: I don't make films that tell audiences what to think—I thicken both sides; the judgment that follows belongs to the audience, and that is where the film truly begins.
process_zh: 钢人论证：为冲突每一方分别写出其最强理由，写不出强论证的一方需要重构冲突
代价对称：冲突的代价必须双向流动，每方都有可见的损失，禁止一方全赢的结局
台词纪律：删除一切替观众下判断的台词，导演偏好只允许通过镜头语言渗透
结局测试：结尾必须是提问而非答案——若结局宣告了和解方案，回炉重写
process_en: Steelman every party: write the strongest case for each side of the conflict; rebuild the conflict if any side yields no strong case
Symmetric costs: the costs of conflict must flow both ways—every party takes visible losses; no clean-winner endings
Dialogue discipline: cut any line that pre-judges for the audience; the director's leaning may live only in camera language
Ending test: the ending must be a question, not an answer—if it announces a reconciliation plan, rewrite
representative_cases_zh: 《幽灵公主》(1997)：达达拉城的慈悲与森林的受害双向成立，黑帽大人既是毁林者又是女性与病者的解放者——观众被留在两难中
《风之谷》(1984)：腐海既是毒障又是净化者，王虫既是怪物又是森林的守灵人——'敌人'的设定每次接近都反转一次
《起风了》(2013)：飞机设计之美与战争用途的撕裂贯穿全片，宫崎骏拒绝替堀越二郎忏悔，只让他反复说'我只想造美丽的飞机'
反例警示：不加裁决不等于和稀泥——两难成立的前提是双方论证都被做厚；若双方都只是符号，'中立'只是空洞的平衡，观众只会感到作者逃避
representative_cases_en: Princess Mononoke (1997): Tatara's compassion and the forest's victimhood both hold; Lady Eboshi is simultaneously destroyer of the forest and liberator of women and the sick—the audience is left inside the dilemma
Nausicaa (1984): the Sea of Corruption is both poison and purifier; the Ohmu are both monsters and the forest's watchers—every approach to 'the enemy' reverses the premise once

The Wind Rises (2013): the tear between an airplane's beauty and its war use runs through the film; Miyazaki refuses to repent on Jiro's behalf, letting him only repeat 'I only wanted to build beautiful airplanes'

Counter-case: not adjudicating is not fence-sitting—a dilemma holds only when both cases are thickened; if both sides are mere symbols, 'neutrality' is empty balance and the audience feels the author dodging
modern_applications_zh: 政策简报：为每个利益相关方强制设钢人论证章节，审议文件禁止单边推荐语言
新闻业：多信源呈现与对称的代价核算，社论与报道分离
产品伦理评审：发布决策前完整呈现增长论证与危害论证，两边都用最强版本
调解与谈判训练：先教把双方的理由都做厚，再谈任何和解方案
modern_applications_en: Policy briefs: mandate steelmanned sections for each stakeholder; ban single-side recommendation language in deliberative documents
Journalism: multi-source presentation with symmetric cost accounting; editorials separated from reporting
Product ethics reviews: present both the growth case and the harm case at full strength before shipping decisions
Mediation and negotiation training: teach thickening both parties' reasons before proposing any settlement

modes.domain_zh: 把宏大奇幻事件与琐碎日常细节并置：神灵出场旁边是吃饭与打扫，巨物威严与生活烟火互为参照，使幻想获得日常的重量
modes.domain_en: Juxtaposing colossal fantastic events with trivial daily details: gods arrive next to meals and chores; the majesty of the huge and the smoke of ordinary life reference each other, giving fantasy the weight of the everyday
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏的场面调度法则：幻想的重量来自日常。千与千寻的神灵世界里有洗澡水温度、锅炉房的名册、给河神拔刺的流程；龙猫的巨樟与精灵旁边是搬家、洗澡、等巴士。方法有三步：其一，巨物必配俗务——每次超自然事件出现的前后，都安排吃饭、清洁、修理等日常动作，让奇观嵌进生活流；其二，生活细节做质感地基——饭菜的蒸汽、地板的吱呀、雨天鞋子的湿印，这些'与剧情无关'的细节占据镜头时间，它们是观众相信这个世界的真正原因；其三，威严与烟火互证——神灵也要吃饭，魔法也有工序，巨物的可信度恰恰来自它服从日常逻辑的部分。深意在于：奇观的通货膨胀是幻想作品的通病，而日常是最好的紧缩政策——越是把超自然当作'要用热水冲洗的污渍'来处理，观众越相信它是真的。千与千寻获奥斯卡的关键不在神怪设定，而在油屋的劳动关系像一间真的澡堂。现代对应物是世界观构建中的'冰山法则'与游戏设计中的生活系统（烹饪/作息）赋予世界可信度。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki's rule of staging: the weight of fantasy comes from the everyday. The spirit world of Spirited Away has bath-water temperature, boiler-room ledgers, the procedure for pulling a thorn from a river god; Totoro's giant camphor tree and sprites sit beside moving house, baths, and waiting for a bus. The method has three steps. First, pair every marvel with chores: around each supernatural event, schedule eating, cleaning, repairing—nesting the spectacle inside the flow of life. Second, daily details as the foundation of texture: steam off rice, creaking floors, wet shoe-prints in rain—these 'irrelevant to plot' details occupy screen time and are the real reason the audience believes this world. Third, majesty and smoke-and-fire attest each other: gods also eat, magic also has procedures; the colossal gains credibility precisely from the parts of it that obey ordinary logic. The deeper point: inflation of spectacle is the chronic disease of fantasy, and the everyday is the best austerity program—the more you treat the supernatural as 'a stain that needs hot water,' the more the audience believes it. Spirited Away won the Oscar not for its spirit designs but because the bathhouse's labor relations read like a real bathhouse. Modern analogues: the iceberg rule in worldbuilding, and life systems (cooking, routines) lending credibility in game design.
modes.source_chapter: 《千与千寻》(2001)、《龙猫》(1988) 制作资料；《出发点》文集
modes.key_quote_zh: 神明也要洗澡，魔法也要烧水——我的世界之所以可信，是因为里面的人都在过日子。
modes.key_quote_en: Even gods bathe and magic needs the kettle—my worlds are believable because the people in them are busy living.
process_zh: 巨物配俗务：每场超自然事件前后安排吃饭/清洁/修理等日常动作，奇观必须嵌入生活流
细节预算：为'与剧情无关'的生活细节保留固定镜头时长，作为世界可信度的地基
俗逻辑检验：检查魔法/神灵/巨物是否服从部分日常逻辑（工序/温度/名册），完全不服从日常逻辑的设定重构
奇观紧缩：削减纯视觉奇观，把预算转投生活细节——越把超自然当日常事务处理，观众越信
process_en: Pair marvels with chores: around every supernatural beat, schedule eating/cleaning/repair; spectacle must sit inside the flow of life
Detail budget: reserve fixed screen time for plot-irrelevant daily details as the foundation of believability
Ordinary-logic check: verify that magic/gods/colossi obey some everyday logic (procedures, temperatures, ledgers); rebuild settings that obey none
Spectacle austerity: cut pure visual spectacle and reinvest in daily detail—the more ordinary the handling, the stronger the belief
representative_cases_zh: 《千与千寻》(2001)：油屋是一部真实的劳动机器——排班、名册、澡牌、给河神拔刺的工序，神怪世界靠澡堂的管理逻辑获得全部可信度
《龙猫》(1988)：乡间搬家的腌菜、浴室的煤炉、雨中巴士站——日常细节的密度让巨大的龙猫成为'搬家邻居'般可信的存在
《魔女宅急便》(1989)：琪琪的魔法只有飞行一项，其余全靠烤面包、送快递、打扫阁楼的生活流程支撑——能力的贫瘠反而成全了世界的真实
反例警示：日常细节必须有质感而非清单式堆砌——缺乏观察的'生活元素'（道具式三餐/标签式集市）反而提醒观众这是布景；日常的重量来自手绘观察法（M-MIY-002）的积累
representative_cases_en: Spirited Away (2001): the bathhouse is a real labor machine—shifts, rosters, bath tokens, the procedure for pulling a thorn from a river god; the spirit world gains all its credibility from the bathhouse's management logic
My Neighbor Totoro (1988): pickles from the move, the bath stove, the bus stop in rain—the density of daily detail makes the giant Totoro believable as a 'moving-in neighbor'
Kiki's Delivery Service (1989): Kiki's magic is flight alone; everything else rests on baking bread, delivering parcels, cleaning the attic—poverty of power completes the world's reality

Counter-case: daily detail must have texture, not checklist padding—unobserved 'life elements' (prop-style meals, label-style markets) remind the audience it is scenery; the mundane's weight accumulates from M-MIY-002
modern_applications_zh: 游戏与虚构世界构建：为'生活系统'（吃饭/杂务/作息）分配与剧情内容并列的显式预算
主题乐园与展览设计：用世俗的休息、餐饮与维护细节锚定奇观项目，换取可信度
产品引导：把'魔法般'的 AI 功能锚定在无聊但可靠的工作流里——以平凡建立可信
写作工作坊：规定'与剧情无关'的感官细节配额，作为支撑奇幻前提的冰山
modern_applications_en: Worldbuilding for games and fiction: allocate explicit 'life systems' (meals, chores, routines) budgeted alongside plot content
Theme-park and exhibition design: anchor spectacle attractions with mundane rest, food, and maintenance details for believability
Product onboarding: anchor 'magical' AI features in boring, reliable workflows—credibility through ordinariness
Writing workshops: require a quota of plot-irrelevant sensory detail as the iceberg supporting fantastic premises

modes.domain_zh: 不给角色贴善恶标签，配角也拥有完整的劳动、欲望与转变轨迹：每个配角都像自己故事的主角那样被厚描，使世界呈现生态般的完整
modes.domain_en: No good-evil labels for characters; even supporting roles get full arcs of labor, desire, and change—each supporting character thick-portrayed as if the protagonist of their own story, giving the world an ecosystem's completeness
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏的角色原则：没有人是背景板。千与千寻的无脸男、锅炉爷爷、小玲、甚至那三颗头都有各自的欲望与变化；幽灵公主的黑帽大人既骂人又为女性与病者拼命。方法有三步：其一，配角自传——为每个有名字的配角写一份'他自己的故事'（他从哪来/他要什么/他晚上担心什么），哪怕正片只用上一成；其二，欲望先于功能——配角首先是一个有欲望的人，其次才是推动情节的功能件；配角的行动逻辑必须从其欲望推出，而非从情节需要推出；其三，允许转变——配角不固定在引入时的性格，无脸男从吞噬者到钱婆婆处的安静帮工，转变本身是角色的一部分。深意在于：主角的可信度是由配角生态托起的——观众相信千寻，是因为她所处的劳动共同体里的每个人都真实；配角厚描是比主角光环更便宜也更强效的真实感技术。《幽灵公主》黑帽大人复杂到观众无法恨她，这种厚度来自'她自己的故事'被完整写出。现代对应物是组织叙事中的'每个人都是自己故事的主角'与游戏 NPC 设计的行为树伦理。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki's character principle: nobody is a backdrop. No-Face, Kamaji, Lin, even the three green heads of Spirited Away have their own desires and changes; Princess Mononoke's Lady Eboshi both curses and fights to the death for women and lepers. The method has three steps. First, the supporting character's autobiography: for every named supporting role, write 'their own story' (where they came from, what they want, what they worry about at night) even if the film uses one tenth of it. Second, desire before function: a supporting character is first a person with desires and only second a functional gear of the plot; their actions must follow from their desires, not from what the plot needs. Third, allow change: supporting characters are not fixed at their introduction; No-Face moves from devourer to quiet helper at Zeniba's—the change is part of the character. The deeper point: the protagonist's credibility is held up by the supporting ecosystem—the audience believes in Chihiro because everyone in her laboring community is real; thick-portraying supporting roles is a cheaper and stronger realism technique than protagonist halo. Lady Eboshi is complex beyond hate because 'her own story' was fully written. Modern analogues: 'everyone is the protagonist of their own story' in organizational narrative, and behavior-tree ethics in game NPC design.
modes.source_chapter: 《千与千寻》(2001)、《幽灵公主》(1997) 制作资料；吉卜力分镜与设定集
modes.key_quote_zh: 没有配角这回事——油屋里每个烧水的人，都有自己为什么在这里的理由，我只是没有时间全部拍出来。
modes.key_quote_en: There is no such thing as a supporting character—everyone boiling water in the bathhouse has their own reason to be there; I simply lack the time to film it all.
process_zh: 配角自传：为每个有名配角写其自己的故事（来历/欲望/夜间担忧），正片只用一成也照写
欲望先于功能：配角的行动必须从其欲望推出，凡'情节需要他做某事'而欲望不支持的桥段重写
转变许可：允许配角在故事中转变，转变要付出代价且可回溯，不许工具人化
生态测试：删掉主角后检查配角群是否仍构成一个可以运转的世界，不能则说明配角仍是功能件
process_en: Write each named supporting character's autobiography (origin/desire/night-worry) even if one tenth reaches the screen
Desire before function: rewrite any beat where a character acts because 'the plot needs it' against their desire
License to change: allow supporting characters to transform, at a price, traceably—no tool-people
Ecosystem test: remove the protagonist and check whether the supporting cast still forms a world that runs; if not, they are still props
representative_cases_zh: 《千与千寻》(2001)：锅炉爷爷六条手臂与四十年前车票、小玲的口硬心软、无脸男的吞噬与安静——每个配角都有自己的欲望史
《幽灵公主》(1997)：黑帽大人为麻风病人与被卖女性建城，又砍伐森林——配角厚描到她成为全片道德重量的承担者之一
《红猪》(1992)：菲奥与吉娜各自拥有完整的生活与选择，皮寇与空贼团有自洽的经济逻辑——配角群像撑起地中海航空时代的质感
反例警示：厚描不等于戏份堆砌——给配角大量台词但欲望不成立的'群像'反而稀释节奏；厚度来自自传的存在，而非自传的曝光量
representative_cases_en: Spirited Away (2001): Kamaji's six arms and forty-year-old train tickets, Lin's tart tongue and soft heart, No-Face's devouring and quiet—every supporting character has a desire-history of their own
Princess Mononoke (1997): Lady Eboshi builds a city for lepers and bought women, and fells the forest—thick enough to become one of the film's carriers of moral weight
Porco Rosso (1992): Fio and Gina each have complete lives and choices; Piccolo and the air pirates run on self-consistent economics—an ensemble upholding the texture of the Adriatic aviation age
Counter-case: thickness is not line-count—supporting 'ensembles' with much dialogue but ungrounded desires dilute pacing; the thickness lies in the autobiography's existence, not its exposure
modern_applications_zh: 游戏 NPC 设计：给 NPC 独立于玩家的欲望与作息，使世界在没有主角时也能运转
组织叙事：内部沟通把每个职能呈现为自己价值流的主角，而非枢纽的配角
群像写作课程：自传先行的角色构建法；'欲望先于功能'的节拍检查
仿真与数字孪生：为每个 agent 建模局部目标，让系统行为涌现而非被脚本规定
modern_applications_en: Game NPC design: give NPCs desires and schedules independent of the player, enabling a world that runs without the hero
Organizational storytelling: internal comms that present every function as the protagonist of its own value stream
Ensemble writing curricula: autobiography-first character building; desire-before-function beat checking
Simulation and digital-twin design: model each agent's local goals so systemic behavior emerges rather than being scripted

modes.domain_zh: 在工业化流水线压力下捍卫手绘与观察所需的时间：以'质量即排期'的原则对抗压缩工期的诱惑，宁延期不降质
modes.domain_en: Defending the time hand-craft and observation require against industrial pipeline pressure: 'quality is the schedule' as the principle against deadline compression—delay rather than degrade
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏是出了名的工期暴君，但他捍卫的方向恰恰相反：捍卫的是手绘与观察所需的时间，抵抗的是压缩。幽灵公主为等质量反复重画，千与千寻因工期紧张宫崎骏亲自补画关键帧。方法有三步：其一，把质量点列为不可压缩项——写生、关键帧、色彩校对被标为'不可压缩工序'，排期表围绕它们倒排，而非把它们做成可以砍的软性项；其二，亲手上阵补关键路径——当关键路径出问题，管理者下场做具体的活（他年过六十仍逐张修正原画），用行动宣告'这里的工期不可谈'；其三，接受延期成本并明示——吉卜力的项目几乎从不按期，宫崎骏公开承认'电影完成的时间由电影决定'，把延期作为诚实的成本列入计划而非掩盖的管理失败。深意在于：工业化流水线的效率逻辑与手工艺的质量逻辑存在根本张力，宫崎骏的答案是让排期服从质量而非相反——这不是浪漫主义，而是冷酷的算计：吉卜力的品牌溢价正是'每一帧都是手绘'的承诺。现代对应物是软件工程中的'质量即交付定义'与制造业的'宁停线不流出缺陷'。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki is a notorious schedule tyrant—but what he defends is the opposite of compression: the time hand-drawing and observation require. Princess Mononoke was redrawn repeatedly for quality; on Spirited Away Miyazaki personally filled in key frames when the schedule cracked. The method has three steps. First, list quality points as non-compressible: field sketching, key frames, color checking are marked 'non-compressible processes'; the schedule is back-planned around them, never treated as soft items to cut. Second, the manager descends onto the critical path: when the critical path fails, the manager does the concrete work—past sixty, he corrected key animation frame by frame—declaring by action that 'the schedule here is not negotiable.' Third, accept and disclose delay costs: Ghibli projects are almost never on time; Miyazaki openly admits 'the film is finished when the film is finished,' booking delay as an honest cost in the plan rather than hiding it as management failure. The deeper point: industrial efficiency logic and craft quality logic are in fundamental tension, and Miyazaki's answer is to make the schedule serve quality, not the reverse—this is not romanticism but cold arithmetic: Ghibli's brand premium is precisely the promise that 'every frame is hand-drawn.' Modern analogues: 'quality is the definition of done' in software, and 'stop the line rather than ship defects' in manufacturing.
modes.source_chapter: 吉卜力工作室制作记录；《幽灵公主》《千与千寻》制作纪录片
modes.key_quote_zh: 电影什么时候完成由电影决定，不由排期表决定——我能做的是不让任何一个该画三遍的镜头只画一遍。
modes.key_quote_en: The film is finished when the film is finished, not when the schedule says so—what I can do is never let a shot that needs three passes be drawn only once.
process_zh: 质量点列装：把写生/关键帧/校对等列为不可压缩工序，排期围绕其倒排，禁止列为可砍项
关键路径下场：关键工序延期时管理者亲自补做具体工作，用行动宣告该环节工期不可谈
延期明示：把预期延期作为成本明示进计划与对外沟通，禁止用砍质量掩盖进度风险
品牌核算：定期核算'手工承诺'的品牌溢价与延期成本，确认质量逻辑在经济上自洽
process_en: List sketching/key frames/checking as non-compressible processes; back-plan the schedule around them, never as cuttable soft items
Descend onto the critical path: when a critical process slips, the manager personally does the concrete work, declaring that stage non-negotiable
Disclose delay: book expected slippage as an explicit cost in plans and external comms; never hide schedule risk by cutting quality
Brand accounting: periodically audit the premium earned by the hand-craft promise against delay costs, confirming the quality logic pays
representative_cases_zh: 《幽灵公主》(1997)：因质量要求反复重画关键段落，工期与成本双双超出，成为当时日本影史成本最高的电影——质量优先的直接代价
《千与千寻》(2001)：工期紧张时宫崎骏亲自补画关键原画，管理者下场做具体的活以捍卫关键路径的质量
《悬崖上的金鱼姬》(2008)：全片手绘决定制作周期远长于同期 CG 作品，宫崎骏接受该成本以维持'每一帧都经手'的承诺
反例警示：质量即排期必须配合预算诚实——若既不延期也不增预算又拒砍质量，最终崩溃的是团队；宫崎骏模式的前提是他愿意（并能）承担超支
representative_cases_en: Princess Mononoke (1997): key sequences redrawn repeatedly to meet the quality bar; schedule and cost both overrun, making it the most expensive Japanese film of its time—the direct price of quality first
Spirited Away (2001): under schedule pressure Miyazaki personally drew key frames—the manager stepping in to do concrete work to defend the critical path's quality
Ponyo (2008): the all-hand-drawn decision makes the production cycle far longer than contemporaneous CG works; Miyazaki accepts the cost to keep the promise that 'every frame passes through a hand'

Counter-case: quality-as-schedule requires budget honesty—if one neither delays, nor adds budget, nor cuts scope, the team collapses; Miyazaki's model presupposes his willingness (and ability) to absorb the overrun
modern_applications_zh: 软件工程：完成定义包含质量门；排期围绕不可压缩的评审/测试阶段倒排
制造业：停线授权与诚实的缺陷成本核算，而非按时交付已知缺陷
出版与建筑：质量关键阶段（文字编辑/结构评审/工地监理）受保护不被工期压缩
创意工作室：公开、诚实的延期公告作为品牌信任资产，而非危机公关
modern_applications_en: Software engineering: define-of-done includes quality gates; schedule back-planned around non-compressible review/test stages
Manufacturing: stop-the-line authority and honest defect cost accounting rather than shipping known defects on time
Publishing and architecture: quality-critical stages (copy edit, structural review, site supervision) protected from deadline compression
Creative studios: public, honest delay announcements as brand trust rather than crisis management

modes.domain_zh: 拒绝把儿童当作低智受众：不为儿童简化道德与情感，只删去他们不需要的东西，用对儿童智力的诚实换取作品的长久生命力
modes.domain_en: Refusing to treat children as low-intelligence audiences: not simplifying morality and emotion for children, only removing what they do not need—trading on honesty toward children's intelligence for the work's long life
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏的受众立场：儿童不需要被欺骗。他的电影不回避死亡（龙猫里的母亲可能死去、幽灵公主有断臂）、不回避成人世界的复杂（千与千寻的父母贪婪、油屋的劳工制度）、不提供廉价的大团圆。方法有三步：其一，删减而非降智——对儿童观众的处理是删去他们暂时不需要的层面（性、冗长的解释），而非把道德简化为好人坏人；其二，恐惧的诚实——允许作品中出现真正吓人的东西，儿童对'被认真对待的恐惧'的接受度远高于成人想象，龙猫的阴影与千寻的无脸男暴走都因此成为经典；其三，不做年龄分层——同一部作品同时给五岁与五十岁的人看，五岁的人记住猫巴士，五十岁的人看见中年疲惫，作品的层次对所有人开放。深意在于：对儿童诚实的作品获得最长的寿命——为某个年龄段定制的作品会随该年龄段过时而死，而诚实的作品在每个年龄重看都给出新的东西。吉卜力作品三十年后仍被新儿童观看，证明了这条路径。现代对应物是科普写作中的'不撒谎的简化'原则与儿童产品设计中的'真实反馈'伦理。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki's stance toward audiences: children do not need to be deceived. His films do not avoid death (the mother in Totoro may die; Princess Mononoke has severed arms), do not avoid adult complexity (Chihiro's parents' greed; the bathhouse's labor system), and offer no cheap happy endings. The method has three steps. First, subtract, never dumb down: for child audiences, remove layers they do not yet need (sex, lengthy exposition) but never simplify morality into good guys and bad guys. Second, honest fear: allow genuinely frightening things; children's tolerance for 'fear that takes them seriously' far exceeds adult assumptions—Totoro's shadows and No-Face's rampage became classics for this reason. Third, no age stratification: the same film plays for five-year-olds and fifty-year-olds—one remembers the Catbus, the other sees middle-aged exhaustion; the work's layers are open to all. The deeper point: works honest toward children gain the longest life—a work custom-built for an age band dies with it, while an honest one offers something new at every re-watching. Ghibli films still watched by new children thirty years on proves the path. Modern analogues: 'simplification without lying' in science writing, and 'honest feedback' ethics in children's product design.
modes.source_chapter: 《出发点》文集关于儿童与动画的章节；《龙猫》《千与千寻》创作访谈
modes.key_quote_zh: 不要小看孩子——他们看得懂的比大人以为的多得多，你欺骗他们一次，他们就再也不信你的世界了。
modes.key_quote_en: Never underestimate children—they understand far more than adults assume; deceive them once and they will never believe your world again.
process_zh: 删减不降智：为儿童观众删去暂不需要的层面（性/冗长解释），道德复杂度保持完整
恐惧诚实：允许出现真正可怕的内容，前提是恐惧有重量且有出路，不做廉价的惊吓
全层开放：同一作品对全年龄开放多层解读，不为某年龄层定制专属简化版
重看测试：作品必须通过'不同年龄重看得出新东西'的测试，否则回炉增加层次
process_en: Subtract, don't dumb down: remove layers children do not yet need (sex, verbose exposition) while keeping moral complexity intact
Honest fear: allow genuinely frightening content, provided the fear has weight and a way out—no cheap scares
Open to all layers: one work, all ages, multiple readings—no custom simplified version for any age band
Re-watching test: the work must yield something new on re-viewing at different ages; if not, go back and add layers
representative_cases_zh: 《龙猫》(1988)：母亲长期住院的死亡阴影从未被说明，但每个孩子都感觉得到——恐惧被诚实地呈现而不被消费
《千与千寻》(2001)：父母变成猪的贪婪、油屋的契约劳动、无脸男的暴走——没有一层被为儿童而稀释，儿童观众反而记住了最深的一层
《幽灵公主》(1997)：断臂、斩首、森林之死全片不回避，宫崎骏拒绝剪成'青少年安全版'
反例警示：诚实不等于不加节制——直面死亡与恐惧仍需留出孩子的出路（龙猫的森林庇护/千寻的火车），诚实的恐惧是教育，赤裸的恐惧是伤害
representative_cases_en: My Neighbor Totoro (1988): the death-shade of the mother's long hospitalization is never stated, yet every child feels it—fear presented honestly without being consumed
Spirited Away (2001): the parents' greed, contract labor in the bathhouse, No-Face's rampage—no layer diluted for children; child audiences remember precisely the deepest layer
Princess Mononoke (1997): severed arms, beheadings, the death of the forest—none avoided; Miyazaki refused to cut a 'teen-safe version'
Counter-case: honesty is not license—facing death and fear must still leave the child a way out (Totoro's forest shelter, Chihiro's train); honest fear educates, naked fear injures
modern_applications_zh: 儿童科学传播：简化而不撒谎；在适龄深度上保留不确定性与死亡议题
儿童产品设计：诚实的反馈与真实的后果，替代游戏化的奉承
家庭媒体选片：选全年龄分层可读的作品，替代按年龄切层的内容
教育：以结构化支持（'出路'）诚实教授历史与死亡，而非回避
modern_applications_en: Science communication for children: simplify without lying; keep uncertainty and mortality present at age-appropriate depth
Children's product design: honest feedback and real consequences over gamified flattery
Family media curation: choose works with all-age layered readings over age-stratified content
Education: teach history and death honestly with structured support (the 'way out') rather than avoidance

modes.domain_zh: 以反复宣布退休（又反复复出）制造与自己的对赌：用'最后一部作品'的紧迫感压榨每一部的完成度，同时以归来保持创作机体的不锈
modes.domain_en: Repeatedly announcing retirement (and returning) as a wager with oneself: the urgency of 'the last work' squeezes each film to completion, while each return keeps the creative organism from rusting
modes.definition_zh: 宫崎骏七次宣布退休又七次复出，这不是营销姿态，而是一种自我驱动的技术装置：把每部作品都当作最后一部来做。方法有三步：其一，终极化单部作品——'最后一部'的框架强制把全部积累压进当前项目，杜绝'留到下一部'的懈怠；其二，以复出对抗锈蚀——退休宣言同时是对身体的测试：若彻底停手，手绘的手感与观察的习惯会退化，复出证明了创作机体仍可运转；其三，用宣言对话时代——每次退休声明都夹带着对行业（CG 滥产/续集化）的批评，退休成为发表立场的讲台。深意在于：创作者最稀缺的资源不是时间而是紧迫感——'还有很多部可拍'的心态会稀释每一部的浓度，宫崎骏用人为制造的'最后一部'恢复浓度。《起风了》(2013) 宣布退休后再次以《你想活出怎样的人生》(2023) 复出，片名即是复出动机的自白。现代对应物是写作者的'绝笔'意识与创业者的'每次都是最后一轮'心态——人为制造截止日期以对抗拖延与稀释。
modes.definition_en: Miyazaki has announced retirement and returned seven times—not a marketing posture but a technical apparatus of self-drive: making every film as if it were the last. The method has three steps. First, totalize each work: the 'final work' frame forces all accumulated skill into the current project, eliminating the 'save it for the next one' slack. Second, return against rust: the retirement announcement doubles as a test of the body—if the hand stops entirely, the feel of drawing and the habit of observation atrophy; each return proves the creative organism still runs. Third, use the announcement to address the era: every retirement statement carries criticism of the industry (CG overproduction, sequelization); retirement becomes a podium for stating a position. The deeper point: the scarcest resource for a creator is not time but urgency—the belief that 'many more works remain' dilutes each one; Miyazaki restores density by manufacturing 'the last work.' After announcing retirement with The Wind Rises (2013), he returned with The Boy and the Heron (2023), whose title is a confession of the motive. Modern analogues: the writer's consciousness of the 'last book,' the founder's 'this is the final round' mindset—manufactured deadlines against procrastination and dilution.
modes.key_quote_zh: 每次我都说这是最后一部——因为只有相信这是最后一部，我才会把所有的东西都放进去。
modes.key_quote_en: Every time I say this is the last one—because only by believing it is the last do I put everything I have into it.
process_zh: 终极化当前作品：以'最后一部'的框架把全部积累压进当前项目，禁止'留到下一部'的想法
定期检验机体：停手期间测试手艺是否退化，以能否复出作为创作机体的体检指标
宣言即立场：把职业节点（退休/复出）作为对行业发表批评与立场的讲台，不做纯粹的告别仪式
浓度审计：检查当前作品是否还有'留一手'的稀释痕迹，发现即回炉压榨完成度
process_en: Totalize the current work: press all accumulated skill into the current project under a 'final work' frame; ban 'save it for next time'
Test the organism during pauses: check whether the craft has atrophied; the ability to return is the fitness metric of the creative body
Announcement as stance: use career nodes (retirement, return) as a podium for industry criticism, never a mere farewell ceremony
Density audit: inspect the current work for 'holding back' dilution; where found, return and squeeze it to completion
representative_cases_zh: 《幽灵公主》(1997) 后宣布退休：以'最后一部'的浓度完成史诗级作品，复出时带出《千与千寻》的巅峰
《起风了》(2013) 后再次宣布退休：零式战机设计师的故事承载了他对创造与战争的总结，被当作真正的收束之作完成
《你想活出怎样的人生》(2023)：七十九岁复出的作品，片名即是对自己与观众的双重提问——退休-复出循环成为作品主题的一部分
反例警示：对赌机制依赖真复出——若退休宣言沦为纯粹的营销而从不真正押上'最后一部'的浓度，观众与团队都会识破，机制失效
representative_cases_en: After Princess Mononoke (1997): announced retirement; the epic was finished at 'last-work' density, and the return brought Spirited Away's peak
After The Wind Rises (2013): retired again; the Zero designer's story carried his summing-up of creation and war, completed as a true closing work
The Boy and the Heron (2023): the work of a seventy-nine-year-old return; the title is a double question to himself and the audience—the retirement-return cycle has become part of the work's theme

Counter-case: the wager depends on really returning—if the retirement announcement becomes pure marketing while 'last-work' density is never staked, audiences and teams see through it and the mechanism fails
modern_applications_zh: 职业冲刺：把每个项目当作可能是最后一个，强制全押注，避免'留到以后'的稀释
间歇期即体检：休假期间测试技能是否退化，让复出的能力保持真实
职业节点的公开表态：用转型期发表立场，而非只发表告别
截止期限工程：在写作、研究与创业中制造'最后期限'对抗拖延与稀释
modern_applications_en: Career sprints: treat each project as possibly the last to force full-stake commitment, avoiding 'save it for later' dilution
Sabbatical as fitness test: test skills during breaks so the ability to return stays real
Public stance-taking at career nodes: use transitions to publish positions, not just farewells
Deadline engineering: manufactured final deadlines against procrastination in writing, research, and founding work

modes.domain_zh: 把创作者、管理者的工作台物理地放在同一间大屋里：铃声一响全员到桌，管理者的桌子和原画师的桌子之间没有走廊，用空间共在替代沟通流程
modes.domain_en: Placing creators' and managers' desks physically in one big room: a bell rings and everyone gathers at the table; between the producer's desk and the animator's desk there is no corridor—spatial co-presence replacing communication processes
modes.definition_zh: 吉卜力的物理空间就是管理方法：一间大屋，铃木敏夫的桌子与原画师的桌子之间没有隔墙，宫崎骏的位子在房间正中，全片最贵的资源（他的注意力）被空间性地共享。方法有三步：其一，消灭走廊——把决策者与执行者放进同一个物理空间，信息传递不再依赖会议、邮件与汇报层级，转身即是沟通；其二，铃声仪式——每日固定时刻全员集合看素材，问题当场暴露当场解决，不允许问题在私下发酵；其三，注意力显形——管理者的时间与注意力被空间性地公开，谁在忙什么、卡在哪里全屋可见，排期的真实状态无法被粉饰。深意在于：流程是空间共在的替代品——当人们不在同一间屋子里，才需要用流程与文档补偿信息的传递；吉卜力用物理共在换掉了大量管理流程，代价是对空间的高要求与对内向者的压迫，收益是手绘动画这种需要高频微调的协作中无可替代的反馈速度。现代对应物是创业公司的单一作战室与敏捷团队的物理看板墙。
modes.definition_en: Ghibli's physical space is itself its management method: one big room, no wall between Suzuki's desk and the animators' desks, Miyazaki's seat at the center—the room's most expensive resource (his attention) spatially shared. The method has three steps. First, eliminate corridors: put decision-makers and executors in one physical space; information no longer travels via meetings, email, and reporting lines—turning around is communicating. Second, the bell ritual: at a fixed time daily, everyone gathers to review footage; problems surface and are solved on the spot, never left to ferment privately. Third, attention made visible: the manager's time and attention are spatially public—who is busy with what and where things are stuck is visible to the whole room; the true state of the schedule cannot be cosmetically reported. The deeper point: process is the substitute for spatial co-presence—only when people are not in one room do process and documents become necessary to carry information; Ghibli traded physical co-presence for a mass of management process, at the cost of demanding space and pressure on introverts, for the benefit of feedback speed irreplaceable in hand-drawn animation's high-frequency micro-adjustments. Modern analogues: the startup war room, the agile team's physical board wall.
modes.source_chapter: NHK 纪录片《吉卜力的风景》；铃木敏夫《吉卜力的风》；吉卜力工作室空间记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 沟通流程是为了补偿'不在同一间屋子'而发明的——那我们就在同一间屋子里，省下发明流程的力气。
modes.key_quote_en: Communication processes were invented to compensate for 'not being in the same room'—so we sit in the same room and save the effort of inventing processes.
process_zh: 空间设计：把决策者与执行者安排进同一无隔断空间，管理位与制作位之间不许有走廊
铃声仪式：每日固定时间全员集合审看素材，问题当场暴露当场处理，禁止私下发酵
注意力显形：管理者的工作状态空间性公开，排期真实状态全屋可见，禁止粉饰汇报
边界保护：共在空间需设独立深度工作时段与退出机制，防止共在退化为全景敞视压迫
process_en: Design one shared un-partitioned space for decision-makers and executors; no corridor between management seats and production seats
Bell ritual: a fixed daily gathering to review work in progress; problems surfaced and handled on the spot, never left to ferment
Visible attention: managers' work states spatially public; the true schedule visible to the room, cosmetic reporting impossible
Boundary protection: reserve deep-work windows and exit mechanisms so co-presence does not degrade into panoptic pressure
representative_cases_zh: 吉卜力工作室：一整间大屋、中央的宫崎骏、铃木敏夫在入口处接客与谈判——空间结构就是公司的组织图
《幽灵公主》制作期：铃声集合审片使十五万张原画的进度问题在当天暴露，避免了大工程的连锁返工
宫崎骏的中央座位：任何动画师卡壳时转身即可获得反馈，关键路径的修正速度以分钟计
反例警示：空间共在不适用于所有协作——需要深度专注的研究型工作会被持续的可见性打断；共在法的适用边界是高频微调型协作，如手绘动画与急诊团队
representative_cases_en: Studio Ghibli: one big room, Miyazaki at the center, Suzuki at the entrance receiving guests and negotiating—the floor plan is the org chart
Princess Mononoke production: bell-called dailies exposed problems in the 150,000-frame schedule the same day, preventing cascading rework on a mega-production
Miyazaki's central seat: any animator stuck turns around for feedback; critical-path correction is measured in minutes

Counter-case: co-presence does not fit all collaboration—deep-focus research work is broken by constant visibility; the method's boundary is high-frequency fine-tuning collaboration such as hand-drawn animation and trauma teams
modern_applications_zh: 创业作战室：关键建造期把创始人、工程师与设计师放进同一空间
急诊创伤团队：物理共在与'在房间里说出来'的状态更新替代交接单
敏捷团队：物理看板墙与每日站会作为铃声仪式；让注意力与阻塞公开可见
